user.title: Connect to Savant host
user.description: Enter the IP address (or hostname) of your Savant host. Its stable identity and current control endpoint are discovered automatically.

login.title: Log in to Savant host
login.description: Log in with a host-local account ({host}, “{name}”). This is how the host authenticates a headless client.

devices.title: Savant devices found
devices.description: {count} device(s) available to import on {host}. Choose which to import. Devices excluded by your Lutron choice are omitted. Each imported device is placed in its configured room as an area — you can move it later in Home Assistant.

coolmaster.title: CoolMasterNet devices found
coolmaster.description: This Savant configuration includes CoolMasterNet climate devices. If Home Assistant can reach CoolMasterNet directly, install the built-in CoolMasterNet integration first; retrying Savant setup will exclude exact duplicate climate devices.

lutron.title: Exclude matching Lutron devices?
lutron.description: Found {count} Savant lights and shades that match existing Lutron Caséta/RA2 Select entities. Exclude these matches from the device picker and Savant import inventory, or include them if you want controls from both integrations. Your choice is saved only when you submit the final device picker. Direct Lutron entities are not changed.

menu_options.exclude_lutron: Exclude matching Lutron lights and shades
menu_options.include_lutron: Include them in the Savant device list

reconfigure.title: Refresh Savant devices
reconfigure.description: Log in to download the current device and media-source inventory from {host}.

reconfigure_devices.title: Savant devices found
reconfigure_devices.description: {count} device(s) available to import. Choose the refreshed inventory, including each media source. Devices excluded by your Lutron choice are omitted, even if previously imported. Changes are saved when you submit. Existing entity registry records are not automatically deleted.

error.discovery_failed: Could not discover a Savant host with a stable UID. Confirm Home Assistant is on the same network as the host.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed — check the host-local username and password.
error.no_auth_response: The host did not respond to the login request. The host may only accept local login from the Savant app (see PROTOCOL.md §4.6).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the host on the discovered port.
error.connection_refused: The Savant host advertised a control port but refused the connection. It may be restarting; wait a moment and try again.
error.no_devices: Connected and authenticated, but no rooms or devices were reported by the host.

abort.discovery_failed: Could not discover a Savant host with a stable UID. Confirm Home Assistant is on the same network as the host.
abort.reconfigure_failed: The reconfiguration session was not initialized.
abort.coolmaster_setup_recommended: Set up the built-in CoolMasterNet integration, then retry Savant setup.

init.title: Savant advanced options
init.description: Optional. Update the local account or add a cached hostToken / cloud credentials. Leave blank to keep the current value.

data.rooms: Extra room names (comma or newline separated)
